note: Text one player sends the others during a match. Messages players exchange outside a match do not travel on this connection at all.

fields.name: netId
fields.note: The entity a receiving end attributes the text to where the seat does not name one. Where the seat names a speaker, that is what a receiving end uses instead.

fields.name: localized
fields.note: Whether the text is a phrase to show as it stands, or a key naming one the receiving end looks up and fills in from the parameters. Every message observed carried it clear.

fields.name: paramsLength
fields.note: How many bytes of the run that follows carry meaning.

fields.name: textLength
fields.note: The length of the text, counted in bytes and excluding the byte that ends it. A single byte holds it, so text runs no further than 255 bytes and a whole message no further than 310.

fields.name: params
fields.note: Always thirty two bytes, holding text that ends at a zero byte, which is what fills in a key. A client leaves whatever it is not using as it found it, so those bytes carry memory never written for this message and differ between two messages otherwise alike. A receiving end reads to the first zero byte rather than to the length beside it, so it reads past that length when the run holds no zero byte.

fields.name: text
fields.note: A receiving end reads to the byte that ends the text rather than to the length beside it.

fields.name: terminator
fields.note: A zero byte closing the text. A receiving end depends on it, since it is what stops the read.
